title: Moraine Lake and Lake Louise Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Moraine Lake and Lake Louise on this day tour designed for groups up to 10. This experience allows you to take in the breathtaking natural beauty of the region with a knowledgeable guide who shares insights about the lakes and surrounding mountains. Enjoy the convenience of premium transportation in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. 

- 5 to 6 hours of exploration, including the most iconic sights
- Premium transportation in a NEW air-conditioned vehicle
- Expert local guides
- Convenient pickup from your accommodation in Banff or Canmore
